preconditions.description: n is an even number representing the length of the sequence.
Each integer x_i on the even positions of the sequence is a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate whether a possible sequence exists.

postconditions.expression: output == 'Yes' ==> (x_1, x_2, ..., x_n is a sequence of positive integers and x_2, x_4, ..., x_n are the same as in the input)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes' is output, the sequence must be valid and the even-positioned numbers must match the input.
If 'No' is output, there is no possible sequence that satisfies the given conditions.
